env: .venv-qwenomni, transformers 5.13.0 (upgraded from 5.12.1), torch 2.8.0+cu128, bitsandbytes 0.49.2, compressed_tensors 0.17.1, accelerate 1.14.0
gate2_evidence: config.enable_audio_output=true; model has talker (3.32B params) + code2wav vocoder (0.22B) + code_predictor; documented speakers Ethan/Chelsie/Aiden; audio output sample rate 24000. The Instruct checkpoint is genuinely speech-to-speech capable (NOT text-out only). Measured on meta device: thinker=31.72B, talker=3.32B, code2wav=0.22B.
vram_note: Every single-GPU load path saturated the full 47.4 GiB and OOM'd; the 48 GB card was the binding constraint.

load_paths_tried.result: Model card minimum is 78.85 GB (BF16, FlashAttention2, 15s video) for the Instruct thinker+talker; ~70 GB of raw weights alone. Exceeds 48 GB.

OOM at ~75% of weight load, filled 47.4 GiB. Root cause: the MoE experts are a fused custom module Qwen3OmniMoeThinkerTextExperts (one packed tensor per layer), NOT nn.Linear. bitsandbytes only quantizes nn.Linear, so the ~31B of experts stay bf16 -> ~64 GB -> OOM.
load_paths_tried.verdict: bnb cannot quantize the fused MoE experts; does not fit

load_paths_tried.result: OOM at the last layer. transformers' compressed-tensors path DECOMPRESSES the packed int4 fused experts back to bf16 at load time (DecompressExperts), so the runtime footprint returns to ~64 GB -> OOM. On disk 27.5 GB, but not a true-int4 runtime for the fused experts.
load_paths_tried.verdict: int4 on disk, decompressed to bf16 at load; does not fit

load_paths_tried.path: community int4 checkpoint + device_map=auto, max_memory {0:40GiB, cpu:100GiB} (CPU offload)
load_paths_tried.result: Model LOADED across GPU+CPU. Inference then crashed: AttributeError 'Linear' object has no attribute 'weight' in compressed_tensors.quantization.lifecycle.forward.quantized_forward under an accelerate offload hook. accelerate parameter-offload hooks and compressed_tensors quantized_forward do not compose (offloaded weight not on-loaded before the quantized matmul).
load_paths_tried.verdict: loads with offload but cannot run inference without patching library internals; no valid speech produced

conclusion: On the mandated environment (single 48 GB A6000, transformers stack), Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct cannot be loaded AND run with its native audio-out (talker) path within 48 GB. bf16 needs ~80 GB (multi-GPU); the fused MoE experts have no working single-GPU int4 runtime in the current transformers/compressed-tensors/accelerate stack. Native audio-out is a genuine architectural capability but could not be exercised on this hardware. No reply wav was produced; none was fabricated. MiniCPM-o remains the arch-2 primary.
